roleTitle: I work best where product, engineering, and messy real-world workflows overlap.
paragraphs: I'm Pujan Bajracharya, an end-to-end engineer with a background in product design, full-stack development, AI-assisted workflows, and operational systems.
I like taking vague problems and turning them into structured products: mapping the workflow, designing the interface, building the system, and improving it through use.

highlights.title: Product Thinking
highlights.desc: I start by understanding the user, the workflow, the pain point, and what the system needs to make easier.

highlights.title: Design-Led Engineering
highlights.desc: I use UX, prototyping, and interface design to make complex systems clear and usable.

highlights.title: Full-Stack Execution
highlights.desc: I build interfaces, workflows, APIs, dashboards, and product logic across the stack.

highlights.title: AI-Assisted Systems
highlights.desc: I prototype tools using RAG, OCR, structured extraction, evals, and human review workflows.

callout: The common thread across my work is simple: I build systems that make complicated processes easier to use, verify, and improve.
